products.name: Make (Integromat) AI
products.note: Visual automation platform; AI integrations; EU-hosted options; GDPR workflow compliance

reading.body:
Make operates a visual automation platform that lets non-technical users build AI workflows through a no-code interface, connecting hundreds of third-party apps and AI models without writing code.

The platform's scale—400,000 organizations across 200+ countries—reflects a market where AI integration is now a bottleneck for end users rather than capability itself. Most organizations have the AI models they need. What they lack is a way to wire those models into their existing business systems, data, and human workflows without hiring engineers. Make addresses this by abstracting away the technical plumbing, allowing marketing, IT operations, and CRM teams to compose AI agents from building blocks.

The emphasis on EU hosting and GDPR compliance signals that regional data regulation, not just capability or cost, now shapes where automation infrastructure can run. This matters for AI scaling: a platform that cannot operate in regulated markets cannot scale globally, regardless of model quality or compute access. Make's geographic reach suggests the company has solved this constraint, at least within its software layer.

The data does not reveal how Make consumes compute, whether it runs its own inference or resells access to third-party models, or how its infrastructure costs scale with user adoption. It also does not address whether the platform's ease of use for workflow automation translates into actual demand for new AI workloads, or simply redistributes existing ones.

profile_text.body:
Make is a visual automation platform that describes itself as the leading AI automation platform, trusted by over 400,000 organizations across 200+ countries. The company says it was founded in 2015, is now part of Celonis, and has a global team of 350+. Its site states that users can visually build, scale and automate AI and agentic workflows, connect any app, data source, or AI model, and build automations and AI agents visually, in code, or with a prompt. It also says it offers 400+ pre-built AI app integrations and supports agentic automation that users can see and control.

The tracked product is Make (Integromat) AI, categorized under Automation & Agents, with notes of visual automation, AI integrations, EU-hosted options, and GDPR workflow compliance. The company's site positions Make AI agents as working alongside teams and describes use cases in monitoring, incident response, lead management, and custom communications.

Make is associated with five MCP servers: ai.makeaivideo/video-generator, described as creating finished AI videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts; ai.makerportal/compute, described as deterministic engineering solvers for biquad filter design, room eigenmodes, and LLM VRAM fit; ai.outfitmaker/outfit-assistant, described as weather-aware outfit suggestions for any city and occasion; ai.saymaker/saymaker-mcp, described as generating and editing AI images and video on SayMaker with Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, and Nano Banana 2; and app.makefx/make-effects, described as generating reproducible image, video, and audio assets with leading models and your own provider keys.
